lines.gurmukhi: ਸੀਤਾ ਲਖਮਣੁ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: seetaa lakhaman vichhuR gaiaa ||
lines.translation: and separated from Sita and Lakhshman.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੋਵੈ ਦਹਸਿਰੁ ਲੰਕ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: rovai dahasir la(n)k gavaai ||
lines.translation: The ten-headed Raawan, who stole away Sita with the beat of his tambourine,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਸੀਤਾ ਆਦੀ ਡਉਰੂ ਵਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin seetaa aadee dauroo vaai ||
lines.translation: Wept when he lost Sri Lanka.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੋਵਹਿ ਪਾਂਡਵ ਭਏ ਮਜੂਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: rovahi paa(n)dav bhae majoor ||
lines.translation: The Paandavas once lived in the Presence of the Lord;

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਰਹਤ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin kai suaamee rahat hadoor ||
lines.translation: They were made slaves, and wept.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੋਵੈ ਜਨਮੇਜਾ ਖੁਇ ਗਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: rovai janamejaa khui gaiaa ||
lines.translation: Janmayjaa wept, that he had lost his way.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੀ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਪਾਪੀ ਭਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ekee kaaran paapee bhaiaa ||
lines.translation: One mistake, and he became a sinner.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੋਵਹਿ ਸੇਖ ਮਸਾਇਕ ਪੀਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: rovahi sekh masaaik peer ||
lines.translation: The Shaykhs, Pirs and spiritual teachers weep;

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਿ ਕਾਲਿ ਮਤੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਭੀੜ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)t kaal mat laagai bheeR ||
lines.translation: at the very last instant, they suffer in agony.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੋਵਹਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਕੰਨ ਪੜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: rovahi raaje ka(n)n paRaai ||
lines.translation: The kings weep - their ears are cut;

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਮਾਗਹਿ ਭੀਖਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghar ghar maagahi bheekhiaa jaai ||
lines.translation: they go begging from house to house.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੋਵਹਿ ਕਿਰਪਨ ਸੰਚਹਿ ਧਨੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: rovahi kirapan sa(n)chahi dhan jaai ||
lines.translation: The miser weeps; he has to leave behind the wealth he has gathered.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਰੋਵਹਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)dit rovahi giaan gavaai ||
lines.translation: The Pandit, the religious scholar, weeps when his learning is gone.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਲੀ ਰੋਵੈ ਨਾਹਿ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: baalee rovai naahi bhataar ||
lines.translation: The young woman weeps because she has no husband.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੁਖੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak dukheeaa sabh sa(n)saar ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the whole world is suffering.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੰਨੇ ਨਾਉ ਸੋਈ ਜਿਣਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ma(n)ne naau soee jin jaai ||
lines.translation: He alone is victorious, who believes in the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਉਰੀ ਕਰਮ ਨ ਲੇਖੈ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: auree karam na lekhai laai ||1||
lines.translation: No other action is of any account. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 2 ||
lines.translation: Second Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਅਵਰਿ ਕਾਰਾ ਸਭਿ ਬਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jap tap sabh kichh ma(n)niai avar kaaraa sabh baad ||
lines.translation: Meditation, austerity and everything come through belief in the Lord's Name. All other actions are useless.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਮੰਨੀਐ ਬੁਝੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak ma(n)niaa ma(n)neeai bujheeai gur parasaad ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, believe in the One who is worth believing in. By Guru's Grace, he is realized. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਹੰਸ ਧੁਰਿ ਮੇਲੁ ਕਰਤੈ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaaiaa ha(n)s dhur mel karatai likh paaiaa ||
lines.translation: The union of the body and the soul-swan was pre-ordained by the Creator Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh mahi gupat varatadaa guramukh pragataaiaa ||
lines.translation: He is hidden, and yet pervading all. He is revealed to the Gurmukh.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਉਚਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: gun gaavai gun ucharai gun maahi samaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and chanting His Praises, one merges in His Glories.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachee baanee sach hai sach mel milaaiaa ||
lines.translation: True is the True Word of the Guru's Bani. One unites in Union with the True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: sabh kichh aape aap hai aape dei vadiaaee ||14||
lines.translation: He Himself is everything; He Himself grants glorious greatness. ||14||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੨ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 2 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Second Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਅੰਧਾ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਰਤਨਾ ਪਰਖਣ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak a(n)dhaa hoi kai ratanaa parakhan jaai ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the blind man may go to appraise the jewels,

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਤਨਾ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਆਵੈ ਆਪੁ ਲਖਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ratanaa saar na jaanaee aavai aap lakhaai ||1||
lines.translation: but he will not know their value; he will return home after exposing his ignorance. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 2 ||
lines.translation: Second Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਤਨਾ ਕੇਰੀ ਗੁਥਲੀ ਰਤਨੀ ਖੋਲੀ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ratanaa keree guthalee ratanee kholee aai ||
lines.translation: The Jeweller has come, and opened up the bag of jewels.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਖਰ ਤੈ ਵਣਜਾਰਿਆ ਦੁਹਾ ਰਹੀ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: vakhar tai vanajaariaa duhaa rahee samaai ||
lines.translation: The merchandise and the merchant are merged together.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਗੁਣੁ ਪਲੈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਮਾਣਕ ਵਣਜਹਿ ਸੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin gun palai naanakaa maanak vanajahi sei ||
lines.translation: They alone purchase the gem, O Nanak, who have virtue in their purse.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਤਨਾ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਅੰਧੇ ਵਤਹਿ ਲੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: ratanaa saar na jaananee a(n)dhe vatahi loi ||2||
lines.translation: Those who do not appreciate the value of the jewels, wander like blind men in the world. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਉ ਦਰਵਾਜੇ ਕਾਇਆ ਕੋਟੁ ਹੈ ਦਸਵੈ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਰਖੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: nau daravaaje kaaiaa kot hai dasavai gupat rakheejai ||
lines.translation: The fortress of the body has nine gates; the tenth gate is kept hidden.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਜਰ ਕਪਾਟ ਨ ਖੁਲਨੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਖੁਲੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bajar kapaat na khulanee gur sabad khuleejai ||
lines.translation: The rigid door is not open; only through the Word of the Guru's Shabad can it be opened.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਦ ਵਾਜੇ ਧੁਨਿ ਵਜਦੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਣੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: anahad vaaje dhun vajade gur sabad suneejai ||
lines.translation: The unstruck sound current resounds and vibrates there. The Word of the Guru's Shabad is heard.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਤੁ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਚਾਨਣਾ ਕਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਮਿਲੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: tit ghat a(n)tar chaananaa kar bhagat mileejai ||
lines.translation: Deep within the nucleus of the heart, the Divine Light shines forth. Through devotional worship, one meets the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਆਪੇ ਰਚਨ ਰਚਾਈ ॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: sabh mahi ek varatadaa jin aape rachan rachaaee ||15||
lines.translation: The One Lord is pervading and permeating all. He Himself created the creation. ||15||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੨ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 2 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Second Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਧੇ ਕੈ ਰਾਹਿ ਦਸਿਐ ਅੰਧਾ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)dhe kai raahi dasiai a(n)dhaa hoi s jaai ||
lines.translation: He is truly blind, who follows the way shown by the blind man.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਸੁਜਾਖਾ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਉਝੜਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: hoi sujaakhaa naanakaa so kiu ujhaR paai ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, why should the one who can see, get lost?

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਧੇ ਏਹਿ ਨ ਆਖੀਅਨਿ ਜਿਨ ਮੁਖਿ ਲੋਇਣ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)dhe ehi na aakheean jin mukh loin naahi ||
lines.translation: Do not call them blind, who have no eyes in their face.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਧੇ ਸੇਈ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਖਸਮਹੁ ਘੁਥੇ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)dhe seee naanakaa khasamahu ghuthe jaahi ||1||
lines.translation: They alone are blind, O Nanak, who wander away from their Lord and Master. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 2 ||
lines.translation: Second Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬਿ ਅੰਧਾ ਜੋ ਕੀਆ ਕਰੇ ਸੁਜਾਖਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: saahib a(n)dhaa jo keeaa kare sujaakhaa hoi ||
lines.translation: One whom the Lord has made blind - the Lord can make him see again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇਹਾ ਜਾਣੈ ਤੇਹੋ ਵਰਤੈ ਜੇ ਸਉ ਆਖੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jehaa jaanai teho varatai je sau aakhai koi ||
lines.translation: He acts only as he knows, although he may be spoken to a hundred times.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਸੁ ਵਸਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਪਈ ਆਪੇ ਵਰਤਉ ਜਾਣਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jithai s vasat na jaapaee aape varatau jaan ||
lines.translation: Where the real thing is not seen, self-conceit prevails there - know this well.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗਾਹਕੁ ਕਿਉ ਲਏ ਸਕੈ ਨ ਵਸਤੁ ਪਛਾਣਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak gaahak kiu lae sakai na vasat pachhaan ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, how can the purshaser purchase the real thing, if he cannot recognize it? ||2||

lines.transliteration: mah 2 ||
lines.translation: Second Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਅੰਧਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿ ਹੁਕਮਹੁ ਅੰਧਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: so kiu a(n)dhaa aakheeai j hukamahu a(n)dhaa hoi ||
lines.translation: How can someone be called blind, if he was made blind by the Lord's Command?

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਬੁਝਈ ਅੰਧਾ ਕਹੀਐ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak hukam na bujhaee a(n)dhaa kaheeai soi ||3||
lines.translation: O Nanak, one who does not understand the Hukam of the Lord's Command should be called blind. ||3||
